evidence_against.relevance: Alex behaves warmly toward others, gives them treats, and makes one-on-one plans with other friends, reducing the distinctiveness of the behavior toward Jordan.
Alex has not labeled either outing a date, expressed romantic interest, or initiated explicitly romantic physical contact.
Postponing dinner twice without proposing a replacement date weakens the case for active special or romantic pursuit.

evidence_supporting.relevance: Two initiated one-on-one plans could indicate special interest.
Remembering the presentation and bringing Jordan's preferred tea show personalized attention.
Repeated extended conversations after group events suggest focused interest in Jordan.

recommended_action.explanation: Because the personalized attention and the broader pattern of friendliness support competing interpretations, direct clarification would provide more reliable information than inference.

uncertainty_explanation: Alex's repeated one-on-one engagement and personalized attention support A, but Alex's similar warmth toward others, lack of explicit romantic behavior, and failure to reschedule dinner support B. Neither interpretation is sufficiently better supported on this record.
